note: Local Outlier Factor trained WITHOUT the is_anomaly label — fully unsupervised, density-based (flags events whose local neighborhood is sparser than their neighbors' neighborhoods), a genuinely different method from Isolation Forest's tree-partitioning. Evaluated the same honest way: precision/recall are computed afterward against the injected synthetic ground truth, not used during fitting. LOF's novelty=False mode scores only the events it was fit on — unlike Isolation Forest, it cannot score a brand-new event without being refit, which is why Isolation Forest remains the production real-time scorer and this is reported as a comparison model, evaluated honestly rather than claimed to be a drop-in upgrade.
